# `os-ui/vendor/superset/` — vendored Apache Superset source

This directory holds a **small, attributed, licence-clean slice of Apache Superset source**,
vendored into this Apache-2.0 repository under Apache-2.0. It is the one exception to
`CONTRIBUTING.md`'s "never copy upstream source into this repo", which applies to **bundled
components** (`components/`, consumed as pinned images and subcharts). Nothing here is a bundled
component: these are pure functions compiled into `os-ui`.

The OS's dashboards are **not** Apache Superset and are not branded as it. The permitted form of
words, used everywhere in the product, is *"includes code derived from Apache Superset"*.

## What is vendored

| File | Upstream | Taken |
|---|---|---|
| `echarts/types.ts` | `plugin-chart-echarts/src/{constants,defaults,types}.ts`, `plugin-chart-echarts/src/Timeseries/types.ts`, `superset-ui-core/src/chart/types/Base.ts`, `superset-ui-chart-controls/src/types.ts` | the enums, constants and structural types the slice uses |
| `echarts/series.ts` | `plugin-chart-echarts/src/utils/series.ts` | the pure series algebra: `extractSeries`, `sortAndFilterSeries`, `sortRows`, `formatSeriesName`, `extractGroupbyLabel`, `dedupSeries`, `getChartPadding`, `getAxisType`, `calculateLowerLogTick`, `getMinAndMaxFromBounds` |
| `echarts/timeseries.ts` | `plugin-chart-echarts/src/Timeseries/{transformProps,transformers}.ts` | the `(rows, formData) → EChartsOption` assembly and `transformSeries` |

**Upstream revision:** `apache/superset` @ `c83fb2bb1dcfac41ac51bcebd82471f4a7180d18` (tag `6.1.0`).
The pin is a **commit sha**, not a version: vendored source has no release.

Each file's own header records the exact upstream path, the sha and the **list of changes made** —
read it before changing anything.

## The rules this directory lives under

1. **Never rewrite an upstream header.** Every file keeps its ASF licence header **verbatim**
   (Apache-2.0 §4(a)/(c)), followed by a `Modified from apache/superset <path> @ <sha>` notice
   naming the changes (§4(b)). `scripts/check-structure.mjs` enforces all three as the hard
   `VENDOR-LICENCE-HEADER` rule, and `core/ui/charts/vendor-licence.test.ts` asserts the same in
   the test suite. Because ASF policy forbids rewriting third-party headers, this tree is
   **excluded** from the repo's `FEATURE:` / `USER STORY:` / `ARCHITECTURE:` header ratchet and
   included in the licence-header ratchet instead.
2. **Superset's `NOTICE` stays reproduced** (§4(d)) — `licenses/notices/Apache-Superset-NOTICE.txt`
   and the repo `NOTICE`. Do not touch either to "tidy up".
3. **Never `npm i` an `@superset-ui/*` package.** Every one of them was last published 2024-12-10
   and peers on React `^16.13.1`; installing one would silently put a second React tree in the
   lockfile against this repo's React 19. Vendor pure functions, never components.
4. **Pure functions only.** Never a Superset React component, container, Redux store, theme file,
   `SupersetClient`, `/api/v1/chart/data` call, filter container or SQL Lab file — and never
   anything touching Superset's permission model. The OS's query seam is
   `/api/dashboards/panel-query` → `runPanelQuery`, under the viewer's own identity.
5. **No new dependency.** This tree imports nothing — not `echarts`, not `lodash`, not `antd`, not
   `@emotion`. `core/ui/charts/register.ts` is the only module in `os-ui` allowed to name
   `echarts`, and a ratchet test keeps it that way, so the vendored code declares the option and
   series shapes structurally instead.
6. **One consumer.** Only `core/ui/charts/` imports from here; tabs reach it through that surface.

## Licence recording

The vendored source is recorded, pinned to the sha above, in:

- `licenses/components.tsv` — `Apache Superset (vendored source)`
- `THIRD-PARTY-LICENSES.md` — the mirrored row
- `os-ui/core/kernel/licenses.ts` — the in-product About → Licenses list
- `NOTICE` — the derivation sentence
- `sbom.cdx.json` — regenerated by `scripts/license-check.sh --update-sbom`

`scripts/license-check.sh` must stay green and **no new SPDX id may enter the gate**.
